<string name="advanced_fast_horizontal_navigation_subtitle">Increase D-pad repeat speed in rows while keeping repeat throttling enabled.</string>
<string name="advanced_fetch_focus_scroll_subtitle">Use Fetch’s custom global focus scroll animation and positioning.</string>
<string name="advanced_rgb565_subtitle">Use lower-memory 16-bit color for eligible opaque images. Changing this restarts the app.</string>

<string name="advanced_hardware_bitmaps_subtitle">Keep posters and backdrops in graphics memory for smoother scrolling (Android 8+). RGB565 no longer applies to those images. Turn off if images flicker or show up black. Changing this restarts the app.</string>
<string name="advanced_compose_highlighter_subtitle">Flash borders around recomposing UI elements for performance debugging.</string>
<string name="advanced_clear_cw_cache_subtitle">Remove cached thumbnails, titles, and enrichment data for Continue Watching</string>
<string name="profile_remember_last_profile_subtitle">Skip the profile picker and open the last profile. Turn off to ask for a profile at start-up. A profile with a PIN always asks.</string>
<string name="advanced_confirm_exit_subtitle">Fully terminate the app and free memory when exiting. Requires pressing back twice to confirm.</string>
<string name="playback_section_player_title_desc">Default player, internal engine and error fallback.</string>
<string name="playback_section_stream_selection_desc">How a stream is picked when you press play.</string>
<string name="playback_section_up_next_desc">Next episode autoplay and post-play suggestions.</string>
<string name="playback_section_interface_desc">Overlays, clock and details shown during playback.</string>
<string name="playback_section_video_desc">Frame rate matching, Dolby Vision and HDR.</string>
<string name="playback_parental_guide_sub">Show content warnings when playback starts. Sends each title\'s IMDb ID to api.tiffara.com to look them up.</string>
<string name="auto_skip_intro_sub">Skip intros and anime openings automatically.</string>
<string name="auto_skip_outro_sub">Skip outros and anime endings automatically.</string>
<string name="auto_skip_movie_credits_sub">Skip movie credits automatically, keeping post-credits scenes.</string>
<string name="playback_auto_switch_internal_player_on_error_sub">If stream startup fails, switch between ExoPlayer and libmpv automatically.</string>
<string name="playback_external_forward_subtitles_sub">Fetch subtitles in your preferred language from addons and pass them to the external player.</string>

<string name="playback_external_send_skip_segments_sub">Pass resolved intro/outro skip timestamps to the external player for auto-skipping. Only works in players that support it; other players ignore it.</string>
<string name="playback_resolution_matching_sub">Allow display mode changes to match video resolution.</string>
<string name="playback_resolution_matching_unsupported_sub">Display reports only one resolution; matching may have no effect.</string>

<string name="playback_afr_capability_both_problem_body">Auto Frame Rate and resolution matching are both enabled, but your display reports only one refresh rate and one resolution. Neither may take effect, and it is recommended to disable both.</string>

<string name="playback_afr_capability_only_afr_unsupported_body">Auto Frame Rate is enabled but your display reports only one refresh rate. Switching may have no effect, and it is recommended to disable.</string>

<string name="playback_afr_capability_only_res_unsupported_body">Resolution matching is enabled but your display reports only one resolution. Matching may have no effect, and it is recommended to disable.</string>
<string name="playback_player_auto_desc">ExoPlayer for Movies & TV Shows · MPV for Anime</string>
<string name="playback_engine_mvplayer_desc">Uses libmpv with Fetch OSD controls. Experimental.</string>
<string name="playback_true_black_letterbox_sub">Leave the bars around the picture unpainted so HDR stays true black. Keep this off if a bright line appears on the bars.</string>
<string name="audio_lang_original_hint">Requires TMDB enrichment to be enabled</string>
<string name="audio_remember_delay_per_device_sub">Save and restore the in-player audio delay for the current audio output route</string>
<string name="audio_number_of_channels_desc">Sets the speaker layout used for FFmpeg downmix.</string>
<string name="audio_enable_downmix_subtitle">Uses the FFmpeg downmix path. Requires Prefer app decoders (FFmpeg). When disabled, audio follows the previous Android/device path.</string>
<string name="audio_force_optical_passthrough_sub">Transcodes multichannel formats (TrueHD, DTS, AAC, etc.) to Dolby Digital 5.1 in real-time for Optical/SPDIF connections.</string>
<string name="dv7_handling_dialog_subtitle">Choose how DV streams are processed at playback time.</string>
<string name="dv7_mode_auto_desc">Detects your display and picks the best mode. If playback issues occur, try HDR10 base layer.</string>
<string name="dv7_mode_hdr10_base_layer_desc">Ignore Dolby Vision enhancement data. Can help on devices that support HDR but struggle with DV Profile 7.</string>
<string name="dv7_mode_dv81_libdovi_desc">Convert DV7 to single-layer DV8.1. Requires Dolby Vision display.</string>
<string name="dv7_mode_off_desc">Pass DV7 through unmodified. May glitch on hardware that does not support DV Profile 7.</string>
<string name="dv7_mode_strip_dv_desc">Removes the Dolby Vision RPU layer from all streams.</string>
<string name="audio_dv5_to_dv81_sub">Signal Profile 5 streams as Profile 8.1 for HDR10-compatible output. Helps on devices that do not have a native DV5 decoder.</string>
<string name="audio_strip_hdr10plus_sub">Remove HDR10+ dynamic metadata from streams. When Convert to DV8.1 is also enabled, stripping runs after conversion.</string>
<string name="audio_dv7_preserve_mapping_sub">Keeps original creator-intended tone-mapping at the cost of slightly more processing per frame.</string>
<string name="audio_mpv_hi10p_gnext_sw_subtitle">Use G-NEXT software decoding when stream details identify H.264 Hi10P. Off by default; enable only if Hi10P playback freezes or fails.</string>
<string name="audio_mpv_hwdec_dialog_subtitle">Select how libmpv should use hardware decoders.</string>
<string name="audio_mpv_hwdec_legacy_direct_copy_desc">Previous default behavior: try direct hardware first, then copy-back.</string>
<string name="audio_mpv_hwdec_auto_safe_desc">Safer automatic mode with fallback when some hardware decoders fail.</string>
<string name="audio_mpv_hwdec_hardware_copy_desc">Uses hardware decoding with copy-back to software memory.</string>
<string name="audio_mpv_hwdec_hardware_direct_desc">Uses direct hardware decoding. Fastest path on compatible devices.</string>
<string name="audio_mpv_hwdec_disabled_desc">Disables hardware decoding and uses software decoding only.</string>
<string name="sub_strip_sdh_desc">Hide sound descriptions and speaker labels from text subtitles</string>
<string name="autoplay_preload_next_episode_sub">Start searching for sources in the background before the next episode button appears.</string>
<string name="autoplay_post_play_recommendations_sub">Show recommendations near the end of movies and series.</string>
<string name="autoplay_post_play_movie_threshold_sub">Choose when movie recommendations appear. Episodes follow the Next Episode Threshold setting.</string>
<string name="autoplay_next_episode_fallback_sub">Auto-select first available stream if binge group is not found. When off, shows the stream picker instead.</string>
<string name="autoplay_prefer_binge_group_sub">Try the same source profile first (same addon/quality group) before normal auto-play rules.</string>
<string name="autoplay_reuse_binge_group_sub">Remember and reuse the last binge group across sessions (Continue Watching, Details, etc.).</string>
<string name="autoplay_timeout_sub">Wait time for addons before selecting.</string>
<string name="layout_section_custom_poster_desc">Use artwork from an external poster service.</string>
<string name="layout_fullscreen_hero_backdrop_sub">Expand the hero backdrop to fill the entire screen.</string>
<string name="layout_discover_location_in_sidebar_desc">Discover gets its own item in the side panel.</string>
<string name="layout_overall_ratings_sub_off">Standard and TMDB ratings are Hidden. MDBList provider settings take priority on detail pages.</string>
<string name="layout_episode_ratings_sub">Choose which episode ratings are visible.</string>
<string name="layout_section_streams_desc">Display settings for stream results and player source panels.</string>
<string name="layout_cw_enabled_sub">Show the Continue Watching row on the home screen.</string>
<string name="layout_use_episode_thumbnails_cw_sub">Use episode thumbnails as default image. When disabled, uses backdrop.</string>
<string name="layout_episode_options_overlay_sub">Choose the appearance shown when holding an episode.</string>
<string name="layout_episode_options_overlay_none_desc">Use the full-screen gradient without episode artwork.</string>
<string name="layout_episode_options_overlay_artwork_desc">Use the full-screen layout with episode artwork.</string>
<string name="layout_episode_options_overlay_blur_desc">Use the full-screen layout with blurred episode artwork.</string>
<string name="layout_blur_cw_next_up_sub">Blur unwatched episode thumbnails in Continue Watching to avoid spoilers.</string>
<string name="layout_next_up_furthest_episode_sub">Show next episode based on the furthest watched episode. Disable for rewatches to use the most recently watched episode instead.</string>
<string name="layout_show_unaired_next_up_sub">Include upcoming episodes in Continue Watching before they air.</string>
<string name="layout_cw_sort_mode_sub">How Continue Watching items are arranged</string>
<string name="layout_cw_sort_streaming_desc">Released items first, upcoming at the end</string>
<string name="layout_cw_sort_split_upcoming_desc">Move unaired episodes to a separate Upcoming row</string>
<string name="layout_trailer_play_in_background_sub">Play the trailer in place of the backdrop while the page stays visible.</string>
<string name="layout_trailer_pause_on_scroll_sub">Pause the trailer when you scroll down and resume it when you return to the top.</string>
<string name="layout_trailer_4k_sub">Play trailers above 1080p when available. Uses much more memory; off by default on devices with 2 GB of RAM or less.</string>
<string name="layout_show_full_release_date_sub">For movies, show full release date instead of year only.</string>
<string name="layout_custom_poster_description">Provide a poster URL pattern from an external service. If a placeholder has no value for a given title, the original poster is used instead.</string>
<string name="custom_poster_qr_instruction">Scan the QR code with your phone to paste a poster URL pattern</string>
<string name="layout_always_show_landscape_clearlogo">Always Backdrop with Logo for Landscape Posters</string>
<string name="layout_always_show_landscape_clearlogo_sub">Ignore landscape poster from addon and use backdrop with clearlogo overlay instead.</string>
<string name="web_custom_poster_subtitle">Paste a poster URL pattern below and press Save.</string>

<string name="web_custom_poster_placeholders_info">Placeholders: {id} passes all content IDs. {imdb_id}, {tmdb_id}, {tvdb_id}, {kitsu_id} target a single ID type - if unavailable, the original poster is kept. {imdb_id|tmdb_id|kitsu_id} declares supported ID types - the matching one is used, or the original poster is kept. Add ? to make a placeholder optional, resolving to empty instead of skipping: {imdb_id?}. Other placeholders: {id_type}, {typed_id}, {type}, {shape}. Landscape cards only get custom art when the pattern contains {shape}.</string>

<string name="simkl_sync_info_activity">Each refresh first checks whether Simkl reports any changes and downloads only the updates. This follows Simkl’s API rules, reduces unnecessary data use, and helps keep the service stable.</string>

<string name="playback_section_buffer_network_desc">How much content to keep in memory and how to fetch streams.</string>
<string name="playback_net_fetch_performance_mode_sub">Enable native off-heap allocator and scrubbing optimizations.</string>
<string name="playback_net_fetch_performance_mode_not_supported">This feature is not supported by your device.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_custom_sub">Override Media3’s default buffering with the values below. When off, the player uses Media3’s stock buffer durations and target size.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_warning">These settings affect buffering behavior. Incorrect values may cause playback issues.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_min_sub">Minimum amount of media to buffer. The player will try to ensure at least this much content is always buffered ahead of the current playback position.</string>

<string name="playback_buffer_max_sub">Maximum amount of media to buffer. Must be at least the minimum buffer duration. Higher values use more memory but provide smoother playback on unstable connections.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_initial_sub">How much content must be buffered before playback starts. Lower values start faster but may cause initial stuttering on slow connections.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_after_rebuffer_sub">How much content to buffer after playback stalls due to buffering. Higher values reduce repeated buffering interruptions.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_back_sub">How much already-played content to keep in memory. Enables fast backward seeking without re-downloading. Set to 0 to disable and save memory.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_back_reserve">Reserves ~%1$dMB on top of Target Buffer. Raising Max Buffer Duration shrinks this without losing back-buffer time.</string>

<string name="playback_buffer_managed_sub">Caps the buffer to a safe share of this device’s memory. Turn off to set the Target Buffer Size yourself (advanced — large values can crash low-memory devices).</string>

<string name="playback_buffer_target_sub">Maximum RAM used for ahead-buffering. The maximum is calculated from your device’s available memory (Android’s per-app heap limit), so higher-RAM devices unlock larger caps automatically.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_target_managed_hint">Managed by the device memory budget. Turn off Managed Memory Budget to set this.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_target_warning">Warning: above device safe limit (%1$d MB). App may crash during playback.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_target_danger_warning">Danger: Above warning limit (%1$d MB). High crash risk.</string>
<string name="playback_buffer_allow_large_sub">Removes the device-memory cap on the Target Buffer Size slider, allowing values up to 2GB. May crash on devices with less than 2GB of RAM.</string>

<string name="playback_cache_vod_sub">Persist downloaded bytes to disk for the current stream. Extends instant seek-back beyond the in-memory back buffer and survives brief network drops. Only applies to progressive streams (no HLS/DASH).</string>
<string name="playback_cache_auto_size_sub">When on, the cache is sized from free disk space. Turn off to pick a size manually.</string>
<string name="playback_cache_vod_size_sub">Maximum disk usage for progressive VOD cache (LRU-evicted).</string>
<string name="playback_cache_info_auto" formatted="false">Auto mode targets about 10% of free space.</string>
<string name="playback_cache_info_restart">New cache cap applies after app restart when changing between modes/sizes.</string>
<string name="playback_cache_write_warning">On devices with built-in storage write activity is steady and can add wear over time.</string>

<string name="playback_net_custom_sub">Use multiple parallel connections to fetch progressive streams. When off, a single connection is used.</string>

<string name="playback_net_parallel_sub">Use multiple connections in parallel for fetching streams. Activate when you experience buffering although your download speed is definitely more than sufficient.</string>
<string name="playback_net_connection_count_sub">Number of parallel TCP connections. Higher values increase memory usage and throughput but with diminishing returns.</string>
<string name="playback_net_chunk_size_sub">Size of each download chunk per connection. Larger chunks reduce overhead but use more memory.</string>
